name: Kim's Cuts
addr: 191 Old Us Hwy 70 E, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon 9 AM–5 PM; Tue 9 AM–5 PM; Wed 9 AM–5 PM; Thu 9 AM–5 PM; Fri 9 AM–5 PM; Sat 9 AM–4 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: They were friendly and professional on the phone, able to work me in on a busy Saturday. Kim was great--very nice, knowledgeable on what cuts would work best for me and easy to talk to, I didn't have to wait at all. Best of all, I got an excellent haircut and style for a great price. Will definitely go back again and will recommend to my friends!

Gabriella :New Salon Hair Designer at Kim's Cuts. This has been my go to Salon for many many years. And fortunately for me I was able to experienced an appointment with this young lady, Gabriella as she performed the old school style spiral perm in my hair with great conversation and laughs. From the moment I stepped into the Salon with her beautiful smile, followed by professional introductions. Gabriella had my nerves at ease with her sweet disposition. Very professional with hair design questions,thoughts, suggestions. Every tool was neat,tidy,clean. I very much enjoyed this experience and of course you want to know about my hair.....it's beautiful I'm thankful I had the chance to sit in Gabriella's Chair. The whole experience, I have to share felt transforming in every way.
Kim is a great beautician I have lots of friends that go to her. She can do your hair anyway you want an she is real sociable she does a great job on my hair also. She is friendly an out going.
They are always super polite, professional, and willing to work you in for an appointment. I have never had a bad hair cut nor have I been disappointed with the final results. Give them a call!
Great place. Kim always trys her best to give u great service. Clean establishment. Good hair stylist etc.
Stopped in for a quick cut and not only was she able to fit me in but did a fantastic job. Make sure to call ahead, highly recommend
Great professional and kind service...this gal knows her business and cares for her clients..and I am picky about my haircut...5 star rate plus
So happy to find a hairdresser that listens to me. Great price and great service. Tina is my new hairdresser for sure!
This is a great place, I take my wife there every so often to get her eyebrows done. They're very friendly and very affordable.
Kim always, always cuts my hair like I want it. She is awesome!
